children: Cynca Nordic AB (publ) announced on 10 June 2026 that it had entered into a share purchase agreement for the sale of its shares in Flowa Technology AB to Nordic Capital. Completion of the transaction was subject to the receipt of approvals from the relevant authorities and the fulfilment of certain other customary closing conditions.
Following receipt of the required approvals and fulfilment of all remaining conditions, the transaction has been completed today.
Olof Andersson, CFO, Cynca Nordic AB (publ)

Cynca is an industrial group that provides specialised products and services to Nordic industry and infrastructure. The group consists of specialists who through collaboration create synergies and business value for their customers. Cynca has 1,000 employees with its head office in Stockholm.
